intro.heading: I build custom websites, clear and easy to use
intro.tagline: No unnecessary stuff. Every site is unique — I can take inspiration from what you like and adapt it to what you need
intro.servicesOverview: I build websites tailored to each case: from simple pages to interactive projects with forms, search, dynamic content or even text-only sites. Whatever you need, we can plan and build it.
intro.hostingNote: I can handle the domain and hosting if you want to forget about the technical side, or leave it all in your hands. I can also maintain the site month to month, or hand everything over (code, domain and hosting) so it's fully yours with no dependency.

process.title: How we work
process.intro: A simple process with no surprises, from start to finish

step1.title: You tell me your idea
step1.description: We talk about what you need, no commitment or jargon. You can reach out with half an idea and we'll define it together.

step2.title: I prepare a proposal
step2.description: I define the scope, price and estimated timeline. No fine print. If it doesn't fit, no problem.

step3.title: I build the website
step3.description: I build the site with the right technologies for your project and keep you updated on progress.

step4.title: We review together
step4.description: I show you the result before publishing and we adjust whatever is needed. Revisions are included.

step5.title: Final launch
step5.description: The site goes live ready to go. I hand over all access and explain everything you need to know.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: What people usually ask before getting in touch
faq.q1: How much does a website cost?
faq.q1Answer: It depends on the type and what you need. There's no fixed price because every project is different. Tell me what you have in mind and I'll put together a quote with no commitment.
faq.q2: How long does it take to build a website?
faq.q2Answer: A simple static site can be ready in 1-2 weeks. A dynamic or hybrid one can take 3-6 weeks depending on complexity. I give you an estimated timeline when preparing the proposal.
faq.q3: Do I need to know about technology to work with you?
faq.q3Answer: Not at all. I adapt to any level. If you have half an idea, we'll develop it together. If you have it all figured out, even better. No need to know anything about code or servers.
faq.q4: What's the difference between a static and a dynamic website?
faq.q4Answer: A static site displays fixed information and loads very fast. A dynamic one allows things like user registrations, real-time filters or connections to other platforms. Most small businesses start with a static site and expand later.
faq.q5: Do you handle hosting and the domain?
faq.q5Answer: Not by default, but I can take care of it if you don't want the hassle. It would be added to the budget. If you already have your own hosting, I can work with that too.
faq.q6: Can I see how it looks before it goes live?
faq.q6Answer: Yes, always. Before publishing anything I show you the result in a staging environment and we make all the necessary revisions. Nothing goes live until you're happy with it.
faq.q7: Can I make changes after it's published?
faq.q7Answer: Yes. The first 2 weeks of support are included for minor tweaks. For bigger changes after that period we'd discuss it as a new project.
faq.q8: Do you only work with businesses or also with individuals?
faq.q8Answer: Both. It doesn't matter if you're self-employed, run a small business or are an individual who wants to build something. If the project makes sense, I'm interested.

responsible.title: Data controller

data.title: Data collected
data.text: Through the contact form we collect name, email address, subject and message. No payment data, sensitive data or data from minors is collected.

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.text: Data is used solely to respond to the enquiry submitted and, where applicable, to manage a collaboration proposal. It is not used for advertising or any other purpose.

legal.title: Legal basis
legal.text: Processing is based on the consent of the data subject, freely given by submitting the form (Art. 6.1.a GDPR).

storage.title: Data retention
storage.text: Data is retained for as long as necessary to handle the enquiry. Once resolved, it is deleted unless a contractual relationship justifies its retention.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.text: Data is not shared with third parties. Messages are received in a Gmail account (Google LLC), subject to Google's privacy terms and the applicable international data transfer agreement.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to jarquebusiness@gmail.com. If you believe the processing is not correct, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: This site does not use tracking or third-party cookies. Only strictly necessary technical cookies required for the site to function are used.
